import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from subject import compute_freshness_score


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_zero_days():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    created_at = now
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert score == 1.0


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_one_week():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 8)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * 7)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9
    assert 0.89 < score < 0.91


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_four_weeks():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 29)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * 28)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9
    assert 0.59 < score < 0.61


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_eight_weeks():
    now = datetime(2025, 2, 26)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * 56)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9
    assert 0.34 < score < 0.36


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_future_created_at():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    created_at = datetime(2025, 1, 8)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert score == 1.0


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_large_time_span():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    created_at = datetime(2000, 1, 1)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    days_old = (now - created_at).total_seconds() / 86400
    expected = math.exp(-0.015 * days_old)
    assert abs(score - expected) < 1e-9
    assert score < 0.01


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_monotonic_decay():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    scores = []
    for days in range(0, 100, 10):
        created_at = now - timedelta(days=days)
        scores.append(compute_freshness_score(created_at, now))
    for i in range(len(scores) - 1):
        assert scores[i] > scores[i + 1]


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_freshness_score_asymptotic_to_zero():
    now = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
    created_at = datetime(1900, 1, 1)
    score = compute_freshness_score(created_at, now)
    assert score > 0.0
    assert score < 1e-10
